name: GUILAB Data Center / Colocation / Cloud (Centre Emetteur de Kipe)
developer: GUILAB SA (La Guineeenne de Large Bande)
notes: Operator-published data-center/colocation/cloud service at C/Ratoma, Centre Emetteur de Kipe, Conakry (Guilab S.A., +224 628 222 100, NOC +224 620 303 030). Operator states 228.91 m2, Pylone/Meet-Me-Room/COLOC rooms, two 96-fibre links between MMR and COLOC, public grid + 2 x 400 kVA generators, 72-hour battery autonomy, ASHRAE temperature range, precision cooling 1+1, FM200 fire suppression, access control, 24/7/365. ISO 9001:2015 is an operations certification, not a Tier/Uptime certificate. Rack count and IT load/MW unknown. ACE landing station and IXP-GUINEE may share the Kipe estate; landing station is connectivity, not counted as a separate DC.

name: Data Center National (national datacenter / .gn launch)
notes: Inaugurated / mise en service on 2025-09-04 at the ARPT headquarters, Koloma, Ratoma commune, Conakry, together with repatriation/launch of the .gn national domain; framed under Simandou 2040 (pillar 3 Infrastructures/Transport/Technologies); Orange data price cut 25%. A-grade for the event/status from the Presidency; minister quote gives 600 m2 and 'certifie Tiers 3' (B-grade claim; no Uptime/engineering certificate). Legal operator, funding source, racks/MW, detailed power design and production cutover unknown; Le360 (Mar 2026) reports exploitation/maintenance discussions and energy challenges (B). .gn registry hosting is a workload, not a separate facility.
